ModMetaData.name: A RimWorld of Magic (Continued)
ModMetaData.author: HUGINN (Original author: Torann)
ModMetaData.description:
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/10172696784972477713/0CF87253012F99C7FB2AF528749B60D513BFECEC/[/img]
[b]Magic for your colony[/b] Mages, warriors, summons, scrolls, staves and enchanted equipment. Odyssey adds magical ships, mana networks, life support and shields.
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/15284087167230911780/B4EDF06D1C3DCFE3CBFF2ED7C82AEF12BC7A76C8/[/img]
[b]Classes & skills[/b] 36 base progression paths and 200+ spell/skill families, grouping ranks. Addon classes are extra. Spirit rebirth is a separate ritual path.
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/13924547871489888852/C358ED5524C6DA83EF3F6C3E6EEB0315F262554E/[/img]
[b]New progression · optional beta[/b] Books unlock class stages; practical trials lead to mastery and ascension. The Grimoire shows resources and requirements. Existing progression is retained; class addons stay classic.
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/16867629445839424729/09D218B0FFC71EC75B5B04C06C230C25AA19A7B7/[/img]
[b]Spirit gameplay[/b] An ascended Necromancer can return a deceased colonist as a Spirit. Keep identity and progression; use former class skills through a host. Soul Stones allow recovery: one week in a new host.
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/15915068878910789735/FAA567AAB25035E0E225B07F1F583E15EB2B680C/[/img]
[b]Optional integrations[/b] VGE 1/2, VPE/VEF, Kure, HAR, Pawnmorpher, Giddy-Up, Simple Sidearms, Multiplayer, MedPod, Hellsing, Isekai Dungeons and Logging Framework.
[h2]Important · RimWorld 1.7[/h2] Requires: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2009463077]Harmony[/url] · [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3312959701]JecsLite[/url] · [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3833946439]RWoM Core[/url] Optional adapters: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3833946677]RWoM Integrations[/url]. Install matching package releases; load Integrations after Content and its target mods. Do not combine JecsLite with original JecsTools.
Beta progression is off by default; changing it requires a restart. Keep save backups. DLC is only needed for its features; space content requires Odyssey. Keep Integrations enabled on VGE saves that use its components.
[b]Compatibility:[/b] Multiplayer coverage varies by ability/mod setup. Full CE compatibility is unverified, including Techno Weapon and Super Soldier specializations. ISEKAI RPG LEVELING's tested name gate does not recognize this fork.
Report bugs in Discussions with versions, class, progression mode, steps and Player.log. Saves help with load-related issues. [url=https://github.com/kelnmaari/RWoM]GitHub[/url]
Prefer RWoM 1.7 closer to the original, without my reworks? [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3828893021]Use this alternative fork[/url].
[h2]Credits[/h2] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1201382956]TorannD[/url] — original creator HUGINN — continuation Zaljerem — JecsLite Nevelian and contributors — translations.
Developed with Torann's permission and support. AI assists development and some artwork.
